text:
maya: Quick thread: craft a launch post + compact battlecard focused on pricing story vs cloud APIs and infra vendors. Emphasize predictable unit cost and graceful degradation. Webinar date: 2024-08-14. Goal = AE-qualified demos + SDR nurture list.
che: Agree. Hero stat: median cost/token $0.0011 (Redwood) vs $0.0032 (typical cloud). Use conservative language and cite appendix.
rolf: I'll do a one-page "When to choose" flow (hosted -> dedicated -> private) with short pros/cons for each. Add a tiny ROI worked example for mid-market.
tess-sdr: Routing rules: if title contains "Platform" or company_size >= 500 -> AE_queue; else SDR. EU leads -> EU queue. Tag regulated industries for SE follow-up. Need 2 email templates and 30s intro.
ops-bot: benchmark CSV uploaded: https://storage.redwood/bench/pricing_lab_aug2024.csv
maya: Tone: business-first, avoid infrastructure deep dives. Include 3 fast rebut lines: 1) "We already run on cloud" -> "Cloud gives compute; Redwood gives serving economics and fallbacks." 2) "Lock-in concerns" -> "We support private deployments & clear exit paths." 3) "Numbers look synthetic" -> "See appendix + replayable demo; we used customer-like traces."
che: Webinar demo: 6m recorded demo showing p95 & steady throughput under load, then 8m talk track on levers (batching, caching, quantization). Keep demo clip for SDRs.
rolf: Deliverables: launch post (che), battlecard + ROI (rolf), webinar slides + demo script (che), SDR emails + playbook (tess-sdr), infra sign-off (maya). Check-in 48h.
tess-sdr: HubSpot pseudo-rule I'll implement and QA with ops: ``if role contains ["CTO","Head of ML"] or company_size >= 500 -> AE_queue else if lead_score >= 60 -> SDR_priority else -> nurture_sequence``
maya: Great. Keep copy tight and source all numbers. Drop drafts in Notion and ping product for sign-off. Thanks team. :rocket:
